<thought>Based on the ESI mass spectrum, the base peak at m/z 114.06808 corresponds to the [M+H]⁺ ion. Subtracting the proton mass (1.007276 Da) gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of 113.0608 Da. The formula C₆H₁₀O₂ has an exact monoisotopic mass of 114.06808 Da for the protonated species, matching the observed peak, and its neutral mass is 113.0608 Da. Therefore the molecular formula of the sample compound is C6H10O2.</thought>
<final_answer>C6H10O2</final_answer>
